title: Transaction recovery journal, schemaVersion 1
description: Stored at .opencode/workplan/<id>.transaction.json and published durably before the first artifact replacement. Its presence means recovery (explicit resume or rollback) is required; it is part of stateHash. Content fields carry the exact bytes, base64-encoded (standard alphabet, padded).

transactionId.description: Random UUID in the reference implementation. Not authority.

operation.description: Reference values: create, create:overwrite, update, patch, reset:draft, reset:markdown-only, checkpoint, compact:apply; D.3 adds reset:wipe (plan, Markdown, archive, checkpoint and dependency targets; sidecars may be deleted) and lets reset:draft delete the checkpoint; D.3.1 lets create:overwrite of an unreadable plan add an archive target (the damaged bytes); recovery uses the operation label recovery:resume or recovery:rollback for its own authorization intent. An operation string never grants authority beyond what journal validation proves.

mode.description: POSIX permission bits (0..0o777) to apply on publication.

x-shiori-rules: hash fields must equal SHA-256 of the decoded content (null with null)
target paths are canonical, unique and belong to this plan's recognized artifact set
a changed normalized planFile requires its exact new Markdown target with null before-image and non-null after-image
every current target must match its before- or after-hash before any recovery write (third state => abort, keep journal)
